canonical_title: NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents
treatment: Covered Oct 21; reinclude only with verified new GA/SKU availability, independently reproduced policy isolation or vulnerability finding, deployment evidence, security limits, or significant specification update.
known_facts: On October 21 at GTC Berlin, NVIDIA announced an OpenShell Reference Architecture pairing Vera Rubin model inference, Vera CPUs for harness/tools, OpenShell sandbox policies, and BlueField-4 with Sentry out-of-band enforcement.
NVIDIA says Sentry can quarantine and stop out-of-policy agents in milliseconds; this is a vendor performance claim, not an independently established universal security guarantee.
Architecture availability must not be conflated with immediate general availability of all BlueField-4 hardware features across all partner systems.
reinclude_only_if: Independent red-team / verification of security boundary, fail closed or quarantine latency with reproducible conditions.
GA/pricing/SKU availability, reference implementation or integration deployment verified by partner.
Officially disclosed OpenShell/Sentry vulnerability, mitigation or substantial functionality change.
notes: Recovery created on 2026-10-24 from runs/2026-10-21/llm-night-gtc-google-cloud.jsonl. Earlier run event records writeback blocked. Curated technical dossier at reports/llm-news/gtc-berlin-2026/README.md is not duplicate-control state.
